subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
The position and positional values or English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b8ac11b28aaf6c8b8936a691aad97ade00ffbc26041b3ca63cec303f5c58ca1.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

Each letter-cluster follows the pattern -1, +4.

Let's check each option:

1. UUX

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7fa54cd4d8161e7f69ff36d267addabbbb791a9f852806f2572d391f6aea917.png] 

This letter-cluster does not follow the pattern -1, +4.

2. VUY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f468213540cba8598085613807fce1b162edefa9952a5cd8133049ad8a36b038.png] 

This letter-cluster follows the pattern -1, +4.

3. KJN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c78034e43065610ffff365a5db6117ca247fc0c18e52f712e4490bcf404c1a70.png] 

This letter-cluster follows the pattern -1, +4.

4. CBF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/728cc45798e19a5cc1422f84a5b1f7b72ab8e122a67488ffebb06aecaf466c74.png] 

This letter-cluster follows the pattern -1, +4.

Thus, UUX is the odd one out.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 1**".
